Two types of war occur under the commitment problem:

1. Preventive War 

2. Preemptive War: A country might choose to go to war because it is better to fight today than to lose more tomorrow. 


---

In a prolonged war, information is revealed over time just through both sides conducting war. Either side understands eachothers capabilities thereby revealing private information. Because States continue to fight even though there is less uncertainty due to the revealing of both sides private information. Therefore uncertainty alone is usually not the reason these states fight.
